No fixed hours — here's why

Pop-ups & catering, done by pre-order

All Gritz Everythang cooks for events and pop-ups, not walk-in hours. That keeps every plate fresh — and it means ordering ahead is how you guarantee yours.

1

Check the next drop

Follow @allgritzeverythang on Instagram for pop-up dates, menus and catering announcements.

2

Call or email your order

Pre-order at 407-326-8573 or Allgritzeverythang@gmail.com. Planning an event? Ask about catering.

3

Pull up & pick up

Collect your plates at the pop-up: 1768 Gordon Hwy, Augusta, GA. Hot, ready, and worth the drive.
